required_runtime_settings.name: CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
required_runtime_settings.reason: Select the Cloudflare account that owns Browser Run.

required_runtime_settings.name: CLOUDFLARE_BROWSER_RUN_API_TOKEN
required_runtime_settings.reason: Create/manage Browser Run CDP sessions and Live View handoff.

required_runtime_settings.name: L2_PRIVATE_HANDOFF_PATH
required_runtime_settings.reason: Store ephemeral takeover URL outside GitHub with mode 0600.

readiness_rule: Do not mark READY until a real Browser Run session has been created, a private Live View takeover has been delivered outside GitHub, human takeover has been exercised, and the authenticated session has been reused successfully by L2.
fallback_readiness_rule: For cloud/datacenter-blocked sites, require an online self-hosted residential runner with a platform-isolated persistent profile before marking that platform READY.
